SELECT (p2 - p1) * 100.0 / p1 FROM (SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM events WHERE period='P1' AND event_kind NOT IN ('mint','burn')) AS p1, (SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM events WHERE period='P2' AND event_kind NOT IN ('mint','burn')) AS p2)
